name: com.viliwonka.burst-linear-algebra
description: A Burst-compiled linear algebra library for Unity: dense & block-sparse matrices, factorizations (LU/Cholesky/QR/SVD), direct/least-squares/iterative solvers, eigensolvers, FFT, statistics, ML (PCA, k-means) and generators. A natural extension of Unity.Mathematics for larger-than-4x4 problems. Getting ready for production.
